items.q: What kinds of skills are there?
items.a: **New-knowledge** skills that teach something, and **steering/process** skills that fix a repeatable flow.

items.q: What does a basic skill eval compare?
items.a: Tasks run **without vs with the skill**, plus token and time cost.

items.q: What can't a two-arm eval tell you?
items.a: **Which lines** of the skill actually help.

items.q: How do you test a skill item by item?
items.a: Split it into **~25–30 atomic items**, write a Q&A for each, and ask the model **with and without the skill**.

items.q: What do you do with items the model knows both ways?
Which items should you fix first?
items.a: Ones the model gets **right without the skill but wrong with it**.

items.q: Which items are the real value?
items.a: Ones the model gets **wrong without the skill and right with it**.

items.q: How big is the lenient-vs-strict gap for Opus?
items.a: About **70% general understanding** but only **22% of exact details**.
About **$14** in Sonnet and Haiku calls.

items.q: What must you do after trimming a skill?
items.a: **Re-run the task evals** to confirm the score holds with fewer tokens.
